confirm.disableBody: The person will no longer be able to sign in.
confirm.deactivateBody: An inactive employee cannot record attendance.
confirm.suspendBody: The terminal cannot record attendance until it is activated again.
confirm.revokeBody: The terminal key will no longer be accepted.

home.title: Service diagnostics
home.intro: These checks confirm the API, platform database, Redis, and RabbitMQ. Attendance is not enabled yet.
home.timeInvalid: Enter an IANA timezone such as Europe/Stockholm.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.intro: Sign in with the email and password issued for this host. The server decides what you can open.

admin.title: Administration
admin.intro: This page loads your profile from the server.

kiosk.title: Terminal
kiosk.idleBody: Hold the code to the scanner, or type it below.
kiosk.scanningBody: Tap Continue, or let the scanner finish.
kiosk.notEnrolled: This terminal is not enrolled. Attendance stays closed until a device key is registered.
kiosk.enrollBody: Enter the one-time registration code from the tenant administrator.
kiosk.confirm: Check that this is you, then use the fingerprint reader.
kiosk.mockFingerprint: Development fingerprint reader. A hardware bridge is not connected.
kiosk.mockCamera: Development camera. A hardware bridge is not connected.
kiosk.successBody: You can step away. This screen will reset.
kiosk.unavailableTitle: The terminal cannot reach the server
kiosk.unavailableBody: Attendance is paused until the connection returns.
kiosk.timeoutBody: The terminal is returning to the start.

step.waiting_for_fingerprint: Place your finger on the reader

reason.unknown: The terminal could not complete that step.
reason.not_recognized: That code could not be used. Check it and start again.
reason.network: The terminal could not reach the server. Nothing was recorded.
reason.backend_unavailable: The server is not available. Nothing was recorded.
reason.unknown_code: That code could not be used. Check it and start again.
reason.employee_inactive: That code could not be used. Check it and start again.
reason.device_unavailable: The reader or camera is not available.
reason.device_disconnected: The reader or camera is disconnected.
reason.timeout: The reader or camera timed out.
reason.hardware_communication_failure: The terminal could not talk to the hardware.
reason.photo_invalid: The photograph could not be used.
reason.illegal_transition: That attendance action is not available.
reason.device_policy: This terminal does not satisfy the tenant device policy.

devices.title: Terminals
devices.intro: Register a terminal, then enter the one-time code on that terminal. The terminal keeps its own signing key.
devices.name: Name
devices.requireActivation: Require a separate activation after the terminal registers its key
devices.policyHelp: Leave a field empty to allow any value. A listed network, IP range, or application version is required before attendance is accepted.

platform.title: Tenant management
platform.intro: Create and manage company tenants, their languages, time zones, and database provisioning.
platform.createIntro: The tenant becomes active only after the database is provisioned and the server confirms it.
platform.editIntro: These changes update this tenant's platform record. The database connection stays with this tenant.
platform.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens. This cannot be changed later.
platform.domainHelp: Optional. Leave this empty to use the identifier on the platform host.
platform.administratorHelp: Optional. The account is created after provisioning succeeds. No invitation email is sent.
platform.adminFailed: The tenant is active. The administrator account was not created.
platform.provisionIncomplete: The server did not confirm that the operation finished.
platform.invalidSlug: Use a lowercase identifier with letters, numbers, and hyphens.
platform.invalidHostname: Enter a domain name, or leave the field empty when creating a tenant.
platform.invalidTimezone: Enter an IANA timezone such as Europe/Stockholm.
platform.invalidLanguages: Choose at least one language, and include the default language.
platform.duplicate: That identifier or domain is already registered.
platform.slugLocked: The tenant identifier cannot be changed.
platform.defaultLocale: The default language must be one of the enabled languages.
platform.confirmationMismatch: The confirmation did not match the tenant identifier.
platform.provisionFailed: The database could not be provisioned. The tenant was not marked active.
platform.notProvisioned: The tenant database is not provisioned.
platform.lifecycleConflict: That change is not available for the current status.
platform.detailIntro: Review this tenant and apply the actions its status allows.
platform.historyEmpty: No platform audit records for this tenant.
platform.historyUnavailable: Lifecycle history is available to platform administrators.
platform.unreachable: The database did not answer. Tenant data is unchanged.
platform.activateBody: This resumes database provisioning. People can sign in and record attendance only after the server confirms the tenant is active.
platform.suspendBody: People at this company will not be able to sign in or record attendance. Their data stays in place.
platform.reactivateBody: People at this company will be able to sign in and record attendance again.
platform.archiveBody: People at this company will not be able to use attendance. The database is kept. Permanent deletion is a separate step.
platform.dropBody: This removes the tenant database. Suspending or archiving does not do this. Type the tenant identifier to confirm.
platform.dropHelp: Use this only when the tenant is archived and the data must be removed. This is separate from archive.

done.suspend: The tenant is suspended. Sign-in and attendance are stopped.
done.archive: The tenant is archived. Its database is still stored.

platform.limitsUsageIntro: Counts and limits come from the server. A warning appears when usage reaches {{percent}} percent of a finite limit.
platform.usageIntro: These figures come from the server. A limit cannot be changed here.
platform.quotaInvalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 1000000, or choose Unlimited.
platform.quotaReductionWarning: This limit is below current usage. Existing records stay in place. New accounts, employees, or device activations are blocked until usage is within the limit.
platform.quotaExceeded: Limit exceeded: reduce usage or increase the limit

quotaLevel.reached: {{resource}} has reached the limit. Nothing more can be added.
quotaLevel.over: {{resource}} is above the limit. Existing records stay, and nothing more can be added.

explorer.title: Database Explorer
explorer.intro: Read-only view of the platform database and registered tenant databases.
explorer.rowEstimateUnknown: Row count is not estimated for this database.
explorer.truncated: The result was limited to {{count}} rows.
explorer.readOnly: Only a single read-only query is sent to the server. Writes are refused.

errors.network: The service could not be reached.
errors.invalid_credentials: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this resource.
errors.tenant_not_found: This host is not a tenant.
errors.server_error: The server could not complete the request.
errors.not_found: The requested record was not found.
errors.explorer_unavailable: The read-only database explorer account is not configured.
errors.query_rejected: Only a single read-only query is allowed. Protected data and write statements are refused.
errors.query_timeout: The query took too long and was stopped.

quota.users: The user limit has been reached. Contact the platform administrator before more accounts can be added.
quota.employees: The employee limit has been reached. Contact the platform administrator before more employees can be added.
quota.devices: The device limit has been reached. Deactivate an existing terminal, or contact the platform administrator to increase the limit.

configuration.title: Tenant configuration
configuration.intro: These settings apply to this company. The server stores them for this host.
configuration.photoRequired: A photo is required for clock-in

people.title: People
people.intro: Employee records belong to this company. The attendance code identifies the employee. It is not fingerprint verification, and it is shown only when it is created or reset.
people.name: Name
people.codeOnce: Attendance code {{code}}. This identifies the employee and is not biometric verification. It will not be shown again.

workspace.forbiddenBody: Your account does not include this area.
workspace.forbiddenDetail: The server still decides every request. A hidden page is not a security control.
workspace.boundaryTitle: This page could not be shown
workspace.boundaryBody: The rest of the application is still available.
workspace.serverDecides: The server checks every action. These links follow the permissions it returned.
workspace.myDashboardIntro: Your attendance, history, profile, and correction requests.
workspace.teamDashboardIntro: Attendance and people assigned to you.
workspace.hrDashboardIntro: People, organization, attendance, corrections, reports, and audit.
workspace.myAttendanceIntro: Today’s records in the company timezone.
workspace.historyIntro: Your attendance records, shown in the company timezone.
workspace.reviewIntro: Attendance the server allows you to see.
workspace.myCorrectionIntro: Ask for a correction. Approval records an adjustment and leaves the original attendance events unchanged.
workspace.reviewCorrectionsIntro: Requests in your scope. Approval records an adjustment. Rejection leaves attendance unchanged.
workspace.profileIntro: The account the server returned for this session.
workspace.usersIntro: Accounts for this company. The password stays in this form.
workspace.rolesIntro: Replace the roles stored for an account. You cannot remove your own tenant administrator role.
workspace.auditIntro: Recent security-sensitive actions. Secrets are not included.
workspace.settingsIntro: These values apply to this company.
workspace.limitsUsageIntro: These figures are for this company and come from the server. A tenant administrator cannot change the limits.

quotaGuidance.usersWarning: User accounts are approaching the limit. Contact the platform administrator before more accounts are needed.
quotaGuidance.usersBlocked: The user limit has been reached. Contact the platform administrator before more accounts can be added.
quotaGuidance.employeesWarning: Employee records are approaching the limit. Contact the platform administrator before more employees are needed.
quotaGuidance.employeesBlocked: The employee limit has been reached. Contact the platform administrator before more employees can be added.
quotaGuidance.devicesWarning: Active terminals are approaching the limit. Deactivate a terminal that is no longer needed, or contact the platform administrator.
quotaGuidance.devicesBlocked: Active device capacity is full. Deactivate an existing terminal, or contact the platform administrator to increase the limit.

workspace.invalidReason: Enter a reason of 1 to 500 characters.
workspace.invalidComment: Use a comment of at most 500 characters.
workspace.invalidSupporting: Use supporting information of at most 1000 characters.
workspace.invalidPassword: Use a password of 12 to 200 characters.
